description: Unified academic paper search for AI agents. search_all queries arXiv, Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex at once, de-duplicates the same work across corpora (by DOI/title) and re-ranks with Reciprocal Rank Fusion so papers found by several sources rank highest. read_paper returns full arXiv text with formulas as LaTeX. Plus citation graphs, author metrics (h-index), recommendations and full-text snippet search across 220M+ papers. Remote streamable-HTTP, no auth required.
